newsitem.title: USA: Tejas Gas unit to sell Crescent, Ames opers.
newsitem.headline: Tejas Gas unit to sell Crescent, Ames opers.

text.p: Transok Inc, a subsidiary of Tejas Gas Corp, said on Monday it has agreed to sell the Crescent Gas Gathering System and Processing Plant and the Ames Gas Gathering System in Oklahoma to Cherokee Gas Processing LLC.
Cherokee is a joint venture between CMS Energy Corp's international gas pipeline unit and Heritage Gas Services LLC of Tulsa. The purchase price was not immediately available.

The Crescent and Ames Systems consist of approximately 1,600 miles of low pressure gas gathering pipelines, 23,500 horsepower of compression capacity, and a 45 million cubic feet per day gas processing plant located west of Guthrie, Okla., Transok said.
CMS will own a majority of the Crescent and Ames Gas Gathering Systems, Transok said.
